title: Metadata-driven pipelines for a thousand plant and supply-chain data consumers
summary: A Data + AI Summit session describes how a food manufacturer's Databricks-centred platform, built on metadata- and event-driven pipelines, serves about a thousand data consumers across roughly fifty use cases in a supply chain the abstract sizes at twenty factories, and reports multi-million annual savings from reduced factory losses.
publishedAt: Data + AI Summit 2023 (session day not verified)

sources.title: Made in Italy: How Barilla Uses Databricks Lakehouse to Optimize Operations - Data + AI Summit 2023 | Databricks
